name: Slovenian Foods: 14 Traditional Dishes of Slovenia
snippet: Slovenia’s diversity is undoubtedly mirrored in its cuisine, giving birth to a lot of traditional delicacies which are totally different from one another. Slovenia’s climate and the cuisines of its neighboring countries play an important role in shaping many of the country’s most popular dishes.

name: Top 27 traditional slovenian foods to eat in Slovenia
snippet: Experience authentic Slovenian hospitality with the traditional slovenian dinner and dhow in Ljubljana. The evening starts with a welcome drink and dried fruit (“šklojce”), followed by a three-course meal featuring hearty local dishes and a glass of wine or juice.
